title: Sum unsigned 32-bit integers
description: One O(n) scalar loop over an immutable Uint32Array. Addition wraps modulo 2^32.

inputs.generation: xorshift32 seed 0x6d2b79f5, 65,536 Uint32 values, little-endian bytes

oracle.policy: Exact unsigned 32-bit sum modulo 2^32. Both variants must return 145417951.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: The complete returned sum is compared with the frozen oracle and hashed into the run correctness record.

work.tolerance: Items, bytes, additions, and loads must match exactly. Each measured batch has one boundary crossing.
